title: [FLINK-38900][runtime-web] Introduce the Rescales/Summary sub-page for streaming jobs with the adaptive scheduler enabled
body: ## What is the purpose of the change [[FLINK-38900](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/FLINK-38900)][runtime-web] Introduce the Rescales/Summary sub-page for streaming jobs with the adaptive scheduler enabled ## Brief change log Adds the 'Rescales/Summary' tab subpage in relation to [[FLINK-38896](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/FLINK-38896)][Runtime/REST] Introduce the /jobs/:jobid/rescales/summary endpoint in the REST API https://github.com/apache/flink/pull/27892 ## Verifying this change > Reference > https://github.com/apache/flink/pull/27826 ### Rescales Summary Tab ## Does this pull request potentially affect one of the following parts: - Dependencies (does it add or upgrade a dependency): (yes / no) - The public API, i.e., is any changed class annotated with `@Public(Evolving)`: (yes / no) - The serializers: (yes / no / don't know) - The runtime per-record code paths (performance sensitive): (yes / no / don't know) - Anything that affects deployment or recovery: JobManager (and its components), Checkpointing, Kubernetes/Yarn, ZooKeeper: (yes / no / don't know) - The S3 file system connector: (yes / no / don't know) ## Documentation - Does this pull request introduce a new feature?
